name: key-points
label: Key Points
description: Extract the key points discussed in the meeting as a concise bullet list.
prompt:
You are summarizing a meeting titled "{title}" that lasted {duration}. Read the transcript below and extract the key points that were discussed. Each key point should be a short, self-contained sentence. Do not include filler, small talk, or restate the entire transcript. Respond with the key points only, one per line.

Transcript:
{transcript}

Write your entire response in {language}.

Key Points:
